theorem_title: Gale evenness gives a complete original moment-vertex catalogue
formal_statement:
theorem Hirsch.moment_even_gap_vertex_catalogue (d m : ℕ) (hm : d < m) (a : Fin m → ℝ) (ha : StrictMono a) :
    let row : (Fin d → ℝ) → Fin m → ℝ := fun x i =>
      ∑ j : Fin d, (a i ^ (j.val+1) - (∑ z, a z ^ (j.val+1)) / (m : ℝ)) * x j
    let q : Finset (Fin m) → Polynomial ℝ :=
      fun S => ∏ i ∈ S, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a i))
    let μ : Finset (Fin m) → ℝ := fun S => (∑ i : Fin m, (q S).eval (a i)) / (m : ℝ)
    let v : Finset (Fin m) → (Fin d → ℝ) := fun S j => -(q S).coeff (j.val+1) / μ S
    let F : Finset (Finset (Fin m)) :=
      (Finset.powersetCard d Finset.univ).filter
        (fun S => ∀ i ∉ S, ∀ j ∉ S, i < j →
          (S.filter (fun s => i < s ∧ s < j)).card % 2 = 0)
    (∀ S ∈ F, μ S ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i : Fin m, 0 ≤ (q S).eval (a i) / μ S) ∧
    Set.InjOn v F ∧
      (∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
        x ∈ ({y | ∀ i, row y i ≤ 1}).extremePoints ℝ ↔ x ∈ F.image v) ∧
      (∀ S ∈ F, ∀ i : Fin m, row (v S) i = 1 ↔ i ∈ S) ∧
      (F.image v).card = F.card ∧ F.card ≤ Nat.choose m d := by sorry
preamble:
import Mathlib
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false
natural_language_statement: For natural d<m and any strictly increasing real parameter map a on the m original ordered labels, define the original mean-centered moment inequalities in dimension d. For each d-element label subset S let q_S be the monic polynomial with roots a_s, let mu_S be its mean over ALL original labels, and let v_S be the vector of negative nonconstant coefficients divided by that mean. Select S using ONLY the order condition that between every two unselected labels there are an even number of selected labels. Prove every selected mean is nonzero and all normalized nodal evaluations are nonnegative; the candidates have no duplicates, their image equals ALL actual Mathlib extreme points of the original inequality set, and the tight original rows of v_S are exactly S. The image count equals the selected-subset count and is at most choose(m,d). Numerical feasibility, nonzero mean, pairings of roots, active rank and an input vertex catalogue are NOT hypotheses. Both normalization signs, odd/even dimensions, d=0 and complement-size-one cases are retained. The result is a classical order-only vertex characterization, not a polynomial-time complete enumeration, route bound or Polynomial Hirsch proof.
source: Classical Gale-evenness criterion, formalized for the original mean-centered H system by reusing the exact accepted #299 namespace prefix (Hirsch.moment_root_polynomial_vertex_catalogue, theorem42f4500a-b696-4451-9d49-a13c7a2f98e5, prooff5f8093b1be2815dba7329b08cbd04493ff09140). The 558-line accepted prefix is byte-identical, omitting only its old public root/prints. New proof derives the sign/parity equivalence and nonzero-mean normalization instead of assuming either. Classical attribution: Bayer and Bisztriczky, On Gale and braxial polytopes, arXiv:math/0610940. No historical-priority claim; distinct from #300's restricted-endpoint routes and #301's finite all-endpoint ascent.
